description: This file defines a service function getNewUsersOverTime that aggregates new user creation counts over specified time intervals (day, week, month) using MongoDB aggregation. It includes helper functions for date bucketing and formatting, and exports the main function.

methods.name: getNewUsersOverTime
methods.description: Aggregates user creation data over time with specified granularity, returning an object with granularity, start/end ISO dates, and data points.

methods.name: fillMissingBuckets
methods.description: Creates continuous time buckets between start and end dates, merging with existing data points to fill gaps.

methods.name: setToStartOfDayUTC
methods.description: Sets a date object to the start of the day in UTC.

methods.name: startOfMonthUTC
methods.description: Returns a date object representing the start of the month in UTC.

methods.name: startOfISOWeekUTC
methods.description: Returns a date object representing the start of the ISO week (Monday) in UTC.

methods.name: pad2
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zero if necessary to two digits.

methods.name: weekNumberISO
methods.description: Calculates the ISO week number and year for a given date.

methods.name: formatISOWeek
methods.description: Formats a week start date into 'YYYY-Www' ISO week string.
